forgottitle.text: Forgot password · mobile · KEY-1111 · dark and light

forgotnote.text:
Forgot password, how it behaves

• "Forgot password?" sits under the Password field on Sign in and carries the typed email to the next screen.
• The sent state reads the same whether or not the email has an account, so the screen never tells anyone who has signed up. A second request inside 60 seconds also shows the sent state (the first link still works).
• Send again unlocks after 60 seconds, which matches Supabase's limit of one recovery email per account a minute.
• The link opens Ki-Lo on the phone that asked for it (Supabase's PKCE flow keeps the key on that phone). It shows "Signing you in" (the existing signing-in-link board), then Set a new password.
• reset-link-error is for a reset link that is expired, used, or opened on another phone. A broken sign-up link keeps the existing Link not valid board.
• forgot-password-error shows the two sentences that can appear: no connection (drawn), and "Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes, then try again." Both are existing core sentences.

settitle.text: Set a new password · after the reset link

setnote.text:
Set a new password, how it behaves

• The person is already signed in by the link. Leaving this screen without saving keeps them signed in with the old password unchanged.
• Rules: at least 8 characters (the sign-up rule) and both fields the same. Checked on Save, as on Sign in.
• Server errors map to fixed sentences: same password (drawn), a password the server finds too weak, no connection, and a session that has ended ("This reset has timed out. Ask for a new link." with Send a new link).
• Saved: other devices are signed out (proposal, see open questions). Continue opens Dashboard.

morenote.text:
Change password, how it behaves

• The row shows only for an account that can sign in with email and a password. An account that signed in with Google only does not see it (more · account-google-only).
• The screen asks for the new password twice, as KEY-1111 says. Same rules, errors and sentences as Set a new password.
• Saved: the banner confirms it and Save turns into Done, which goes back to More. Other devices are signed out (proposal).
• Forgot password? stays on Sign in for everyone, because a signed-out screen cannot know which kind of account an email belongs to.

questions.text:
Open questions for Zee (defaults drawn)

1. Change password asks for the new password twice only, as the ticket says. Add a Current password field as well? Recommended: yes, it stops someone with your unlocked phone changing it. Not drawn.
2. Sign other devices out after a reset or a change? Drawn: yes.
3. A Google-only person who taps Forgot password gets the email and can set a password, which adds email sign-in to the account. Drawn: allowed, the email says Google sign-in still works.
4. Recovery email: link only (drawn), or the link plus a 6-digit code for opening on another device? Recommended: link only for now.

webtitle.text: Web · forgot password, set a new password, change password · 1280 and 375

webnote.text:
Web, how it differs from mobile

• Same flow, rules and sentences as the mobile boards. Only the place words change: "in this browser" instead of "on this phone".
• Forgot password? sits beside the Password label on the login card, so the card keeps its height.
• Forgot, sent, link error and Set a new password use the login card with no navigation. The link lands on /auth/callback, which sends a recovery to the Set a new password page.
• Change password is a page under More, with a back link to More, like Export my data.
• Sending and saving use the login card's existing button spinner (web · login-pending) and are not drawn again.
• Field errors on Change password look the same as on Set a new password and are not drawn again.

emailnote.text:
Recovery email (Supabase › Reset password template)

Subject: Reset your Ki-Lo password

Hi,

Someone asked to reset the password for the Ki-Lo account {{ .Email }}. If it was you, open this link on the phone or browser where you asked:

[Set a new password]

The link works once, for one hour.

If you sign in with Google, you do not need a password: use Continue with Google.

If you did not ask, ignore this email. Your password stays as it is.

Ki-Lo
